issues.description: Solution query for Aufgabe 05 uses an impossible conjunction for the requested regierungsbezirk filter: it requires Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk to be both 'Oberbayern' AND 'Niederbayern' at the same time. The problem statement asks for Gemeinden in Oberbayern OR Niederbayern. This makes the provided solution return no rows and contradicts the task description, which will confuse students comparing their (correct) OR-based query to the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: In the solution file aufgabe05.sql replace the AND between the regierungsbezirk checks with OR so the WHERE clause reads: AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Oberbayern' OR Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Niederbayern'). This matches the task text and will return Gemeinden in either region as intended.
